notes.title: Demo Now Available, Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/902cc8214986d71cfc2aeef23018a633708e0ef3.png

A free demo is now available to play for The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart!

Just head on over to the Store page to download it, and meet the charming cast of the game, brought to life by leading voice actors!

The beautiful full-HD game features a dual language option that lets you view either English or Japanese text, or both simultaneously.

Moreover, we're happy to share a release date for the game now: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart will release on June 17. Please look forward to it!

We hope you'll enjoy the demo!
